title: Sparkly top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hatGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2a1a4e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a2a7e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="brimGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5a3a9e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a1a6e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sparkGrad">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffee55"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="38" ry="10" fill="url(#brimGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="38" ry="10" fill="#6a4aae"/>

  <!-- hat body -->
  <rect x="28" y="18" width="44" height="52" rx="3" fill="url(#hatGrad)"/>
  <rect x="28" y="18" width="44" height="52" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#7a5abe" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- hat top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="19" rx="22" ry="4" fill="#6a5aae"/>

  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x="28" y="56" width="44" height="9" fill="#cc3355"/>
  <rect x="28" y="56" width="44" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#aa2244" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- band buckle -->
  <rect x="43" y="55" width="14" height="11" rx="2" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <rect x="46" y="58" width="8" height="5" rx="1" fill="#ffaa22"/>

  <!-- sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <g transform="translate(18, 22)">
    <path d="M0,-8 L2,-2 L8,0 L2,2 L0,8 L-2,2 L-8,0 L-2,-2 Z" fill="url(#sparkGrad)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <g transform="translate(82, 30)">
    <path d="M0,-6 L1.5,-1.5 L6,0 L1.5,1.5 L0,6 L-1.5,1.5 L-6,0 L-1.5,-1.5 Z" fill="url(#sparkGrad)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 3 - left -->
  <g transform="translate(12, 55)">
    <path d="M0,-7 L1.8,-1.8 L7,0 L1.8,1.8 L0,7 L-1.8,1.8 L-7,0 L-1.8,-1.8 Z" fill="url(#sparkGrad)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 4 - right -->
  <g transform="translate(88, 58)">
    <path d="M0,-6 L1.5,-1.5 L5,0 L1.5,1.5 L0,6 L-1.5,1.5 L-5,0 L-1.5,-1.5 Z" fill="url(#sparkGrad)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 5 - bottom left small -->
  <g transform="translate(22, 82)">
    <path d="M0,-4 L1,-1 L4,0 L1,1 L0,4 L-1,1 L-4,0 L-1,-1 Z" fill="#ffee66"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle 6 - bottom right small -->
  <g transform="translate(78, 84)">
    <path d="M0,-4 L1,-1 L4,0 L1,1 L0,4 L-1,1 L-4,0 L-1,-1 Z" fill="#ffee66"/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="14" cy="38" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="44" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#ffee77"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#ffee77"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="10" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="8" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
